t: Titan 1700W heavy-duty electric breaker delivers 50J of impact energy for demolition tasks. Suitable for builders and demolition contractors breaking concrete on site or during renovation work. The powerful fan-cooled motor provides reliable performance, whilst an aluminium gearbox ensures durability. Equipped with a lock-on trigger switch for continuous operation with reduced fatigue, and an adjustable auxiliary handle to offer increased control. Supplied with pointed chisel, flat chisel, auxiliary handle and hex key.
